description: Planned v2 benchmark runs (PLAN-v2 Phase 6). scripts/bench.py expands each run into one results file per (task set, seed) and runs them in order with --resume. Block 6.3 (quantisation: 3B Q8_0 and a 7B coder Q4_K_M) is added at Phase 6 once the exact Ollama tags are checked (R-QV-1); the Groq delay is re-checked against the official free-tier limits at CHECKPOINT C.

runs.note: Groq free tier; reasoning model: output tokens include hidden reasoning, so TTFT and tokens/s are not comparable with local rows
